d: A man (Arthur Hill) makes a serious mistake when he tries to do the right thing. With R.G. Armstrong and Rod Cameron.
A woman (Madeleine Sherwood) plots her husband's (James Best) death when she discovers he has been unfaithful. With Diana Van Der Vlis and Joe Flynn.
A man confides in his doctor about his unusual experience involving time travel.
A woman (Betty Field) steps in to help a desperate man (Walter Matthau) save his company from bankruptcy.
A ceramics teacher (Sydney Pollack) at a summer camp finds a boy (Barry Gordon) with an unusual gift for sculpting. With Frank Maxwell.
A distraught woman (Phyllis Thaxter) confronts her former boss (Zachary Scott) on his train ride home.
A famous outlaw (Ricardo Montalban) rides into town and causes a commotion at the local saloon. With Constance Ford.
An aging ex-collegiate hurdler refuses to quit, much to his wife's dismay.
A woman encourages her boyfriend to gain employment with a wealthy exporter.
A woman finds a familiar face when looking through police files after having her purse snatched.
A master clockmaker who escaped Nazi Germany refuses to allow his granddaughter to wed.
A couple (Julie Adams, James Franciscus) is concerned when their daughter acquires an imaginary playmate.
An alcoholic woman (Claire Trevor) tries to reclaim her estranged daughter, who has been raised by another family. With Biff Elliott.
An escape artist desperate for the one big stunt that will make him famous meets with disaster when his wife schemes to turn his death-defying trick into a deadly performance.
